title: HRV BatchExtract: automated batch extraction of Kubios HRV Scientific Lite results
description: Python application that automates batch processing in Kubios HRV Scientific Lite, applying threshold-based artefact correction (medium) to every file and exporting time-domain, frequency-domain and nonlinear HRV results to Excel. Available in English and Portuguese versions. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Kubios Oy.
